blocks.prompt: 10 How many committees of 5 members can be chosen from a group of 8 persons when each committee must include 2 particular persons?
blocks.explanation:
Committee selection hai, lekin shart ke saath: 2 khaas (particular) afraad har committee mein lazmi hain.
Find kya karna hai? Aisi committees ki tadaad.
Plan: pehle un 2 ko committee mein bitha dein, phir baqi \(5 - 2 = 3\) seats baqi \(8 - 2 = 6\) logon mein se bharein.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: 8 afraad; 5 members ki committee; 2 khaas afraad lazmi shamil.
Humein find karna hai: aisi committees kitni hain.
Tareeqa: Jo log pehle se tay hain un ke liye koi choice nahi (sirf 1 tareeqa). Sirf khaali seats ko \({}^{n}C_{r}\) se bharna hai. Roz marra ki misaal: agar captain aur vice-captain pehle se tay hon to sirf baqi team chunni parti hai.

2 khaas afraad ko pehle bitha dein
\[\text{places left} = 5 - 2 = 3\]
\[\text{persons left} = 8 - 2 = 6\]
Kyun: Woh 2 committee mein aa chuke, is liye na unhein dobara chuna ja sakta hai aur na chhora ja sakta hai. Is liye seats bhi 2 kam aur log bhi 2 kam.

Baqi 3 members chunein
\[{}^{6}C_{3} = \dfrac{6 \cdot 5 \cdot 4}{3 \cdot 2 \cdot 1}\]
\[= \dfrac{120}{6} = 20\]
Kyun: 6 logon mein se 3 seats bharni hain, tarteeb se farq nahi. Committee mein koi pehla ya doosra nahi hota, sab barabar ke members hain, is liye combination.
Dhyan dein: \({}^{8}C_{3}\) ya \({}^{6}C_{5}\) likhna ghalat hai; seats bhi kam hui hain aur log bhi.

Tasdeeq: ulti taraf se gin kar
\[{}^{8}C_{5} = 56 \text{ committees in all}\]
\[\text{with both: } 20,\ \text{at most one: } 36\]
\[\text{at most one} = {}^{6}C_{5} + 2 \cdot {}^{6}C_{4} = 6 + 30 = 36 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Jawab ko jaanchne ka achha tareeqa yeh hai ke ulti taraf se ginein. Kul 56 committees mein se jin mein dono khaas log nahi (\({}^{6}C_{5} = 6\)) ya sirf ek hai (\(2 \times {}^{6}C_{4} = 30\)), woh 36 hain. \(56 - 36 = 20\), hamara jawab.
